facility.name: Stacy Braggs
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The operation's written activity plan was unavailable for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not have annual training in Emergency preparedness, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, administering medication, Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, Understanding building and physical premises safety, Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: The primary caregiver cares for children under the age of 2 and did not have annual training in the following topics  - Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome;   -  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and   -  Understanding early childhood brain development
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: The operation did not have operational policies regarding infant safe sleep at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Infant feeding sheets were unavailable to review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §747.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Safety drill logs were unavailable for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 of 4 children's files reviewed were missing an up to date record of immunizations.    The caregiver was able to contact children's parents and 1 of the parents provided the most up to date record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: The operation did not have any operational policies regarding procedures for contacting CCR or accessing inspection reports
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: 1 of 4 children's files reviewed were missing a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation has not entered any information in the CCR portal or informed CCR staff of its liability insurance coverage in over a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.211(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child's admission form did not have authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three children did not have current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The provider did not have a written activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: Activity plan was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Observed a child under two engaged in screentime.     This was corrected when the TV was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: Parent handbook was unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Two of the four children enrolled was missing admission information forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: 30 clock hours of annual training was not completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: Emergency preparedness plan was unavailable to review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Observed broken play equipment in the operation's outdoor space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A blanket was observed inside a crib with an iinfant under 12mos.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency: Observed a blanket in the crib with an infant who was sleeping.    This was corrected when the blanket was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency (26 TAC §747.307(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: CO system was not available to review.     Provider reported that the the CO detector kept beeping which cause the provider to remove the device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the four children enrolled, were missing immunization records
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation has not entered in any information in the CCR portal regarding liability insurance coverage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.211(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Background check for one vistor of the home was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing: Children records were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training: Personnel and training records were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))
